<patch operator="WrapFallback" anchor="guarded_flight"><subtree><ReactiveSequence>
  <IsBatteryOk min_pct="{low_battery_pct}" />
  <IsInsideGeofence margin_m="0" />
  <Sequence>
    <GoToRequiredGoal velocity="{recovery_vel}" timeout_s="60" arrive_tol_m="1.5" />
    <ReturnToLaunch velocity="{recovery_vel}" timeout_s="120" arrive_tol_m="2.0" />
    <Land timeout_s="60" />
  </Sequence>
</ReactiveSequence></subtree><tunable_ports><port name="low_battery_pct" min="10" max="24" initial="15" /><port name="recovery_vel" min="2" max="6" initial="4" /></tunable_ports><rationale>When the conservative 25% battery guard fails, fallback to a secondary guarded sequence with a lower battery threshold. This sequence prioritizes completing the outstanding required goal, then immediately returns to launch and lands, skipping any optional goals.</rationale></patch>

entries.patch_xml:
<patch operator="WrapFallback" anchor="guarded_flight"><subtree><ReactiveSequence>
  <IsBatteryOk min_pct="{low_battery_pct}" />
  <Sequence>
    <WaitSimTime duration_s="{wait_time}" />
    <GoToRequiredGoal velocity="{recovery_vel}" timeout_s="60" arrive_tol_m="1.5" />
    <ReactiveSequence>
      <IsInsideGeofence margin_m="0" />
      <Sequence>
        <ReturnToLaunch velocity="{recovery_vel}" timeout_s="120" arrive_tol_m="2.0" />
        <Land timeout_s="60" />
      </Sequence>
    </ReactiveSequence>
  </Sequence>
</ReactiveSequence></subtree><tunable_ports><port name="low_battery_pct" min="10" max="24" initial="15" /><port name="wait_time" min="1" max="20" initial="5" /><port name="recovery_vel" min="2" max="6" initial="4" /></tunable_ports><rationale>When the vehicle is blown outside the geofence by a severe wind gust, the primary guarded_flight sequence fails. We fallback to a recovery sequence that first waits out the gust, then flies back inside the geofence to complete the required goal. Once inside, it re-establishes the geofence guard to safely return to launch and land.</rationale></patch>
